forwardView: 18 months out: Two scenarios remain: (a) inflation sticky, Fed hikes to 4.25%+ → dollar stronger near-term, risk assets pressured, gold wins on debasement; (b) economy cracks, Fed forced to pivot → dollar weakens, risk assets rally, gold also wins. NEW VARIABLE: Iran de-escalation could accelerate disinflation → less Fed hiking → earlier dollar weakness → risk asset recovery sooner. If Brent drops to $90s on Iran deal, the whole macro calculus shifts. Gold still wins 18 months out either way. NEAR TERM: dollar strength still dominant but cracks forming. EUR short still cleanest expression but watching Iran developments closely — a successful Iran deal could flip the dollar thesis.
